units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 4b:1">B. Bath. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>דקָפֵיל ליה חבריה וכ׳</he> (Rashi: <he>מְקַפֵּל</he>; Ms. M. <he>מְקַפּיל</he>) the neighbor might scrape off (the clay) &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 4b:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מקפיל ליה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>קליף ליה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).

senses.gloss: to dig, unearth (esp. used of grave robbers).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 152b:9">Sabb. 152ᵇ</cite> <he>הנהו קפולאי דהוו קָפְלֵי וכ׳</he> grave robbers that were unearthing (bodies) in the field of &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 376:1">Yalk. Ez. 376</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 33:1">Yalk. Gen. 33</cite> <he>מְקַפְּלֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 44a">Ḥull. 44ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>דאִיקְּפוּל אִיקְּפוּלֵי</he> the gullet and windpipe were loosened by peeling, opp. <he>דאפרוק איפרוקי</he> they were torn off forcibly.
